column1: # What every picture under docs/images shows, as seen by whoever looked.
# One row per picture, tab-separated: file, sha256, date seen, what it shows.
# A picture whose bytes move needs a new row before it is pushed, and the
# last field is written by the one who looked -- never by a machine.
# python3 development/seen_rows.py prints the rows still owed, field four
# left empty; tests/source/source_pictures_seen_test.py holds this file.
